description: The standing permissions of an account on Robinhood Chain: who can move its funds without the owners signing. It reads what the address is (Safe, ERC-7579 smart account, plain wallet, wallet with an EIP-7702 delegate, or another contract), a Safe's owners and threshold (1-of-n flagged, each owner a plain wallet or a contract), every module and the code it runs (Zodiac Roles and Delay named; a module Toll does not know can move everything), each Zodiac Roles member and what each role may call (any function, a function with any arguments, or a function under conditions not read yet; delegatecall and send flagged), who owns the Roles module, a Delay module's waiting period and who may queue on it, the guard, the fallback handler (one that is not Safe's own flagged) and installed ERC-7579 modules. Each finding has a severity (critical / high / medium / info) and a summary line says the strongest one; every part not read is listed as not read, never as none. Facts read from the chain, not advice.
